descriptions.text: Skill Potion. Drinking this adds a single level to the Determine Value skill. Hopefully now you'll realize all those Magic: The Gathering cards are nothing more than just meaningless pieces of paper, and you should have spent your money on something with actual value, like a treadmill. Or shampoo.

recap.text: Carl's trap closes on Yvette, and her mother finishes what the trap started. The Maestro hands Frank and Maggie My a Legendary Skill Potion that takes Find Crawler to level 15. Maggie snatches the potion to find one specific crawler.
Donut drinks a potion in a safe room and gets Acute Ears and fang caps for Mongo. Carl gets explosive and a Scroll of Upgrade for his boxers.

Carl receives the Hell-Kissed Celestial Skill Potion of the Prince of Woe. Mordecai examines it at his table and finds he can brew these himself, with a few more upgrades and some specialized ingredients.

Carl finds a Platinum Hotlist Expansion potion in the Platinum Boss Box for Prison Pocket. He drinks it over the aftertaste of liquefied fish from a broken food box. His hotlist spaces increase from twenty to twenty-five, and he opens a Contingency skill tab for ten programmable automations. Carl suspects Lucia Mar already has this.

beats.headline: Sorted by value
beats.text: The gold Looter Box holds a single item: a potion that adds one level to the Determine Value skill, with a dig at Carl's old Magic: The Gathering cards. He hotlists it and drinks it at once. Nothing seems to happen, but his inventory has a new ability. It still does not say what anything is worth, but it sorts by value: the Tome of Wisp Armor first, then the Chopper, then his one remaining Hobgoblin Detonator. Whatever he has equipped is left off the list.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a potion that adds a Determine Value level, so his inventory sorts by value.

beats.headline: Find Crawler
beats.text: Carl's trap closes on Yvette, and her own mother finishes what the trap started. On his show, the Maestro hands Frank and Maggie My a Legendary Skill Potion that takes Find Crawler to level 15, and Maggie snatches it up. There is exactly one crawler she wants found.
beats.gist: Carl traps Yvette and her mother finishes her; Maggie snatches a level 15 Find Crawler potion.

beats.headline: A History tab
beats.text: The boss box gives Carl yet another Potion of Determine Value, and he wonders why the System keeps handing him these. He drinks it, and his inventory gains a few new sort options, among them a tab labelled History: much the same junk he carries now, plus the chopper and the potions, scrolls and parts he has used up. Sorted by value, its top three are Valtay Corp items he has never seen: an Orator Relay, a Perso-Shield and a pulse pistol. Then Agatha's dot comes up the map, and he knows where they came from. He took her whole shopping cart into his inventory during the fight with the Ball of Swine.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a Potion of Determine Value; his inventory's new History tab lists his used-up items.

beats.headline: Acute Ears, in a safe room
beats.text: Donut drinks one and comes up with Acute Ears, plus fang caps for Mongo. Carl comes out of the same haul with a great deal of explosive and a Scroll of Upgrade that improves his boxers, which is roughly the ratio he has come to expect.
beats.gist: Donut drinks a Skill Potion for Acute Ears and gets fang caps for Mongo.

beats.headline: One Mordecai can brew
beats.text: The Hell-Kissed Celestial Skill Potion of the Prince of Woe has Mordecai shaking. A Celestial-quality skill potion, he says, is not something he will ever be able to brew; then he takes it to his table to examine before Carl drinks. He comes back to say he was wrong. He can make these, with a few more upgrades to the table and some pretty specialized ingredients, and now he knows the recipe.
beats.gist: Shaken, Mordecai says he can never brew the potion, then admits he can and now knows the recipe.

beats.headline: Hotlist Expansion
beats.text: The Gold Payload Box comes as a small WWII-style gravity bomb, and inside it is a skill potion: Hotlist Expansion, which turns a ten-space hotlist into twenty. Carl remembers that when Lucia Mar was conscripted and he examined her, she had an expanded hotlist. Something cool, he thinks, but not earth-shattering.
beats.gist: Hotlist Expansion, a skill potion from a WWII-style gravity bomb, turns a ten-space hotlist into twenty.

beats.headline: Platinum Hotlist Expansion
beats.text: The Platinum Boss Box for Prison Pocket holds an upgrade potion: Platinum Hotlist Expansion. Carl sends the description to Mordecai and drinks it over the aftertaste of liquefied fish from his broken food box. Twenty hotlist spaces become twenty-five, and a new tab opens for the Contingency skill: up to ten programmable automations, each able to fire several hotlist items at once under conditions he sets. Lucia Mar, he suspects, already has this.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a Platinum Hotlist Expansion potion over the aftertaste of liquefied fish.
